scenes.text: Would you pay a thousand dollars for a burger?
It starts with a thick wagyu patty, seared until the fat glistens.
Then it's stacked on a toasted brioche bun.
Next comes a spoonful of caviar, the salted eggs of the sturgeon fish.
And the finishing touch is real, edible, twenty-four karat gold leaf.
Some of these burgers sell for more than a thousand dollars. Would you take a bite? Follow for more.
